source: EPC115-06 SEPA Credit Transfer Inter-PSP Implementation Guidelines 2025 Version 1.0 (effective 5 October 2025), sections 2.2.2 and 2.3.2

reject_pacs002.AG02: Operation/transaction code incorrect, invalid file format
reject_pacs002.CNOR: Creditor PSP is not registered under this BIC in the CSM
reject_pacs002.DNOR: Debtor PSP is not registered under this BIC in the CSM
reject_pacs002.ED05: Settlement of the SEPA Credit Transfer has failed
reject_pacs002.ERIN: The Extended Remittance Information (ERI) option is not supported
reject_pacs002.FF01: Operation/transaction code incorrect, invalid file format
reject_pacs002.RR01: Regulatory reason (missing debtor account or identification)
reject_pacs002.RR02: Regulatory reason (missing debtor's name or address)
reject_pacs002.RR03: Regulatory reason (missing creditor's name or address)

return_pacs004.AC01: Account identifier invalid (i.e. invalid IBAN or account number does not exist)
return_pacs004.AG01: Credit transfer forbidden on this type of account (e.g. savings account)
return_pacs004.AG02: Operation/transaction code incorrect, invalid file format
return_pacs004.CNOR: Creditor PSP is not registered under this BIC in the CSM
return_pacs004.ERIN: The Extended Remittance Information (ERI) option is not supported
return_pacs004.RC01: PSP identifier incorrect, e.g. invalid BIC
return_pacs004.RR01: Regulatory reason (missing debtor account or identification)
return_pacs004.RR02: Regulatory reason (missing debtor's name or address)
return_pacs004.RR03: Regulatory reason (missing creditor's name or address)

notes: FOCR is the only reason allowed for a return that answers a recall (camt.056), per section 2.6 of the same guidelines.
Descriptions are short paraphrases of the SEPA core reasons listed in the guidelines.
